# image

The page's image block: upload, then a resizable image (drag its right edge).
The block keeps its own `<img>` and spreads `useImageViewerTrigger`
(`primitives/overlay/image-viewer`) onto it, so a click opens the full-window
viewer. The hook requires an `<ImageGallery>`, so the block renders its own (a
gallery of one) around the image.
